list.name: Changes
list.comment:
refactor: clean up and document codebase
- Remove unused and dead code across project files - Standardize Python formatting and reduce unnecessary line breaks - Add module and function docstrings throughout the codebase - Add inline comments for key search and response logic - Improve documentation for semantic navigation and candidate matching - Preserve existing search, clarification, and response behavior

task.summary:
feat: add initial web scraper
- Add blank Main.py entry point - Accept a website URL as input - Extract page text and links - Remove unnecessary scripts, styles, and whitespace - Handle request errors

feat: add website search and AI response system
- Add question understanding using AI embeddings - Search through website pages to find relevant information - Choose useful links and avoid revisiting pages - Add found, needs clarification, and not found results - Ask follow-up questions when more information is needed - Generate natural responses using a Hugging Face model - Connect the scraper, search, and response systems

feat: improve answer candidate handling
- Find possible answers from relevant website links - Group similar answer options and filter out unrelated links - Stop searching once answer candidates are found - Keep all found candidates for follow-up questions - Match user clarification to the correct candidate - Use the selected candidate to generate the final answer - Improve handling of questions with multiple possible answers

feat: add chatbot UI and improve response handling
- Add a simple chat interface for asking website questions - Support multiple questions in the same session - Add grounded responses using website evidence - Add follow-up responses after completed requests - Improve detection of similar answer options - Improve handling of differently structured product links

feat: improve clarification and answer handling
- Reject weak clarification matches - Re-search using added clarification when needed - Support single grounded answers on relevant pages - Improve handling of broad product questions - Improve clarification, not-found, and follow-up responses - Preserve conversation state across multiple questions

feat: improve page answer handling
- Find answers directly from page content - Use navigation context to avoid incorrect answers - Keep searching when relevant links are available - Improve support for different website layouts

feat: add support for non-price answers
- Find general answers directly from page text - Detect when navigation reaches a relevant destination page - Generate grounded responses using scraped website evidence

refactor: clean up and document codebase
- Remove unused and dead code across project files - Standardize Python formatting and reduce unnecessary line breaks - Add module and function docstrings throughout the codebase - Add inline comments for key search and response logic - Improve documentation for semantic navigation and candidate matching - Preserve existing search, clarification, and response behavior
